content:
As the Liquid Glass redesign continues to roll out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is testing another visual change, this time focusing on the style of chat bubbles. Here's what we know so far.

A fresh, more rounded chat bubble design

A few months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out the Liquid Glass redesign more widely after months of testing and refinement, distributing it via TestFlight to select user groups.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted signs in the app's code indicating that WhatsApp's chat bubbles would be redesigned. According to the website's latest report, the new bubble design has started rolling out to some users on the latest TestFlight build.

The following is quoted from WABetaInfo's report:

In addition to changes in the shape of message bubbles, the new design also adjusts how media and links are displayed in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green border surrounding them, making photos, videos, animated GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more consistent.

According to WABetaInfo, the new design is currently only available to a small number of WhatsApp TestFlight users, and a timeline for a full rollout to all iOS users has not yet been confirmed.
